# Tano Core 0.9.1

- Introduce Tano Local Windows x64: the public MIT local product without the proprietary Cloud Overlay.
- The first Local installer is an **unsigned preview**. Windows may display a security warning. Verify SHA-256 and public GitHub build provenance before use.
- Local announces versions and links to the matching Core Release for manual installation; it never uses the Product updater feed.
- Reject unsupported workspace formats in native storage and MCP without changing workspace files.
- Improve update status/progress controls and restricted local npm publishing credentials.
- Publish five npm packages and the tano-native crate at Core 0.9.1. Core Releases do not become Product latest.
